country_event = {
	id = mdcw_cw.4
	title = mdcw_cw.4.t
	desc = mdcw_cw.4.d
	picture = GFX_political_deal

	is_triggered_only = yes
	# COLDWAR CW v4 prog2: every target answers (AI by ai_chance); the access can be changed later in the Programmes tab

	immediate = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event mdcw_cw.4"
	}

	option = {
		name = mdcw_cw.4.b
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event mdcw_cw.4 option b"
		custom_effect_tooltip = mdcw_cw_in_access_facilitate_tt
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:mdcw_cw_ev4_partner = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_party@PREV > 0 } }
				}
				var:mdcw_cw_ev4_partner = {
					PREV = {
						set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_access = 2 }
						mdcw_cw_set_pps_access = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 0
			modifier = { add = 10 var:mdcw_cw_ev4_partner = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 0 } check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = PREV.mdcw_cw_alignment } PREV = { has_opinion = { target = PREV value > 49 } } } }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = mdcw_cw.4.c
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event mdcw_cw.4 option c"
		custom_effect_tooltip = mdcw_cw_in_access_permit_tt
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:mdcw_cw_ev4_partner = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_party@PREV > 0 } }
				}
				var:mdcw_cw_ev4_partner = {
					PREV = {
						set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_access = 1 }
						mdcw_cw_set_pps_access = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 2
			modifier = { add = 10 var:mdcw_cw_ev4_partner = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 0 } check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = PREV.mdcw_cw_alignment } } }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = mdcw_cw.4.a
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event mdcw_cw.4 option a"
		custom_effect_tooltip = mdcw_cw_in_access_external_tt
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = mdcw_cw.4.e
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event mdcw_cw.4 option e"
		trigger = { has_political_power > 24 }
		custom_effect_tooltip = mdcw_cw_in_access_restrict_tt
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:mdcw_cw_ev4_partner = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_party@PREV > 0 } }
				}
				var:mdcw_cw_ev4_partner = {
					PREV = {
						set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_access = 3 }
						mdcw_cw_set_pps_access = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 0
			modifier = { add = 20 var:mdcw_cw_ev4_partner = { mdcw_cw_opposing_to_prev = yes } }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = mdcw_cw.4.f
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event mdcw_cw.4 option f"
		trigger = { has_political_power > 49 }
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_cw_pps_expel_tt
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { var:mdcw_cw_ev4_partner = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_party@PREV > 0 } } }
				var:mdcw_cw_ev4_partner = { COLDWAR_cw_pps_expelled = yes }
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 0
		}
	}

}
